# Waitlist Offer Copy

## Primary headline
First 100 waitlist members get free lifetime access.

## Supporting copy
Join the Broono waitlist for early access, launch updates, and a chance to lock in lifetime Pro access before public release.

## CTA lines
- Claim your spot
- Get on the waitlist
- Lock in lifetime access
- Join before the first 100 are gone

## Terms to keep consistent
- Offer applies to the first 100 unique waitlist signups.
- Limit one lifetime offer per person / email.
- Offer converts into account-level lifetime Pro access at launch.
- Broono may contact waitlist members with launch and onboarding updates.
